newsitem.title: USA: Two muni professionals leave FGIC for FSA.
newsitem.headline: Two muni professionals leave FGIC for FSA.

text.p: Alan Steinfeld and Greg Haggerty have left Financial Guaranty Insurance Co to join Financial Security Assurance's competitive new issue area, FSA said Wednesday.
Steinfeld was previously responsible for public finance pricings at FGIC, a unit of GE Capital Services, which is a subsidiary of General Electric Co.
Haggerty managed FGIC's secondary market and new issue competitive bid programs.
Both will be vice presidents and co-managers of FSA's competitive new business.

"As we've expanded our position in the municipal bond market, the demands on our secondary market and competitive bid desks have increased significantly," Thomas Byrne, FSA's director of secondary markets and competitive new issues, said in a statement announcing the hires.
Since the beginning of the year, FSA has added 11 professionals to its municipal department.

FSA, a unit of Financial Security Assurance Holdings Ltd, topped FGIC in the quarterly municipal volume rankings for the first time ever in the third quarter. FSA backed $3.2 billion of debt, compared to FGIC's nearly $3 billion in the period.
